rationale: No candidate plausibly supplied a concrete and material drafting template for the juvenile-delinquency proclamation. C10 is the closest in its advocacy-oriented rhetoric and progression from stated public benefits to an urged course of action, but it addresses Congress in a letter and lacks the child's distinctive machinery of a national conference, Action Reports, coordinated state and community conferences, and continuing local action. C12 and C01 share proclamation conventions and recital-to-operative-clause structure, but those are generic form elements; their substantive legal machinery concerns tariffs and trademark-renewal extensions and has no meaningful parallel in the child.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I further urge them, as the most direct means to this end, to respond promptly to the call of the national Conference...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I therefore strongly recommend that the Congress enact legislation authorizing this great undertaking.
shared_material.explanation: C10 similarly culminates in an exhortation after presenting public-policy reasons, but this is a broad rhetorical pattern rather than a concrete drafting template.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas... Now, Therefore, I, Harry S. Truman, President of the United States of America...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas... Now, Therefore, be it known that I, Harry S. Truman, President of the United States of America...
shared_material.explanation: C12 uses the same standard proclamation architecture, but the similarity is conventional boilerplate and does not extend to operative substance.

shared_material.child_excerpt: In Witness Whereof, I have hereunto set my hand and caused the seal of the United States of America to be affixed.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: In Witness Whereof, I have hereunto set my hand and caused the Seal of the United States of America to be affixed.
shared_material.explanation: C01 shares the routine proclamation attestation clause, which is expressly insufficient to establish template reuse.
